description: The approval page never names the signed-in account outside collapsed Details, and the header shows no account menu or sign-out. A user with two accounts can approve into the wrong one in three steps without any cue; the done card does not name the account either. (Email text itself not verifiable here: test session shows 'Local test session'.)
expected: Account email visible on the card (e.g. 'Approving as elena@...') with a 'Not you? Sign out' link.
actual: Account appears only in Details > Account; no account switcher on the page.
suggested_fix: Show the account under the title and on the done card.

description: After a wrong-account approval the done card offers only Open console (same account); there is no pointer on how to revoke and redo. The footer 'revoke access any time in Console, Agents' is plain text, not a link.
expected: Link to Agents and a hint to rerun login for the other account.
suggested_fix: Link the footer text to Agents.
